scope: prespecified three-single-gate candidate class with hidden gate identity; synthetic information-value experiment, not unrestricted mechanism-family or GRN discovery
CI: 95% chi-square2 Gaussian ball in whitened union-residual coordinates, intersect every gate line, map each beta interval to delta; independent of selected gate
empty_CI: retain, width NaN, not a nonzero certificate
low_CI: all beta intervals unbounded; delta_A and delta_C all real numbers, delta_B singleton zero
primary_risk_comparison: same three-candidate OLS high vs low; every case counted regardless of CI or certification
strong_baseline: high observed-X1 R_AB/R_BC, same three-line GLS and union-ball CI; low unavailable
auxiliary_baseline: delta=0 only; do not invent full query means
independent_unit: 1000 noise seeds; each shares condition noise across four worlds and both layouts
budget_basis: independent analytic min wrong-line squared distance N/8; prespecified joint bound for N64/128/256 is .06990/.70023/.95
expanded_class_boundary: unrestricted simultaneous three-gate 11-column model is NOT the estimator; target unidentifiable even in high design
